title: BoundedFinitePseudoCoherentModel
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring and E an object of D(R) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], pseudo-coherent in the sense of [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Let a,b be integers. Suppose H^i(E)=0 for i<a or b<i. There is a cochain complex P of finite R-modules with P^i=0 for i<a or b<i and an isomorphism Q(P)≅E. No projectivity of P^a is asserted, and no assumption a≤b is needed.

source.place: Tag 066E, lemma-Noetherian-pseudo-coherent, together with truncation at a and b

proof.text: Choose a bounded-above finite-free representative from pseudo-coherence. Truncate it above b by replacing degree b by its cycles. The cycles are a submodule of a finite module over a Noetherian ring, hence finite. The upper cohomology bound makes the truncation map a quasi-isomorphism.

Truncate below a by replacing degree a by the cokernel of the incoming differential. This is finite as a quotient of a finite module. The lower cohomology bound makes the second truncation a quasi-isomorphism. Compose their localization isomorphisms; both strict term bounds persist.

theorem exists_boundedFinite_model {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    (C : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (a b : ℤ) (hC : DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent C)
    (hvan : ∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b < i) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj C)) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ,
      (∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b < i) → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite R (P.X i)) ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ C)
